name: Tradie Ute
summary: Shaded owner-photo review retains the convex lower doors, inset shoulder/glass, crowned cab roof and owner-tape tray/canopy. The curved centre-to-arch underside membrane is replaced by an independent straight central undertray, narrow arch returns and dark inner wheel wells. Rear lamp triplets now match the photo: amber outside, red centre, white inside. Coarse mirror attachment faces buried in the cab are removed; redundant LOD1 barrel discs and tapered LOD2 mirror mounts fund fully closed tyres at every tier. Flat spokes and the faceted profile remain; coarsest rims use a tiny neutral alloy glint. Physics, hinges, pivots, anchors, collision buffers and one paint-key material are frozen. Front styling and precise cab curvature remain estimates because local photos are dark rear obliques.
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.

reference.note: Aspect-preserved actual owner night photo beside previous/current neutral shaded models. Both model candidates use identical cameras, size and framing; photo projection is uncalibrated. Owner photos and tape supersede the generated Muse sheet. Regional lamp/cab comparison and all-LOD negative-elevation underside boards are in the validation evidence. No photographic silhouette IoU is claimed.

shadedComparison.caption: Shaded reference, previous and revised geometry. Previous/current share camera and display scale; reference aspect is preserved. Inspect panel volume, attachments and lower surfaces as well as the outline.

damage.note: Left to right: intact; door_FL and door_RL loose; front and back loose; wheel_FL cambered; front detached; door_FL detached; back (tray and canopy) detached; wheel_FL detached; both front doors and the tray detached; a stripped shell. Posed in a three.js viewer about each part's hinge line; the host renderer cannot draw a second vehicle yet.
